design_notes.note: High peak currents (4 A switch limit) at 2.4 MHz make this the most aggressive conducted emitter of the supply set. Use wide and short traces for the main current path and the power ground tracks; place the input capacitor, output capacitor and the inductor as close as possible to the IC, or the regulator shows both stability and EMI problems.

Use a common ground node for POWER ground and a separate node for CONTROL ground, joined only close to one of the IC ground pins. Superimposing power-ground current on control-ground current causes ground-shift problems. Any sensitive analog ground sharing this plane inherits that shift.

The feedback divider must be placed as close as possible to the control ground pin, with short traces separated from the power ground traces. The FB node is a high-impedance analog node adjacent to a 2.4 MHz switch node.

Thermal performance is set by the board, not the package: improve PCB power dissipation capability, solder the exposed thermal pad to couple the component to the PCB, and consider airflow. Thermal coupling to other heat-generating components is called out explicitly as affecting the dissipation limit.

provenance.notes: Output voltage ripple is NOT specified numerically: section 8.2.2.3 (page 15) only says larger output capacitance gives lower ripple, so emissions.conducted[0].ripple is omitted rather than guessed. di_dt is not stated; the only related figure is the L1/L2 absolute-maximum AC rating of -3 V to 10 V for pulses shorter than 10 ns (page 5), which implies fast edges but is not a di/dt. No dissipation_model: the datasheet gives no power-loss formula for this part, only inductor-current Equation 2. NOTE a documented internal inconsistency -- the Electrical Characteristics table (page 6) specifies the oscillator at 2400 kHz typ, while the variable list under Equation 2 (page 14) says 'f = converter switching frequency (typical 2.5 MHz)'; the specification table value was used. Package body dimensions come from the Description text (3 mm x 4 mm) because the toleranced mechanical drawing pages (31-33) contain no extractable text; package height was therefore not extracted. Page numbers are PDF page numbers, which coincide with the printed page numbers in this document.
